Basically, rightists seem to think that if they just screech loudly enough and make dire enough threats, they can exercise veto power over the supermajority of Americans who think immigration is generally good.




Noah Smith 🐇🇺🇸🇺🇦🇹🇼 (@Noahpinion)

The rightists shrieking about immigration being an "invasion" are a fringe of American society. Most Americans support immigration, and don't think it's destroying the country. 

Let's not be intimidated by a few toxic idiots.
